description: SOUTH JERSEY (KYW Newsradio) — A bipartisan congressional delegation just returned from a week-long trip to Europe, seeing firsthand the impact of the war in Ukraine. Among the group was South Jersey Rep. Donald Norcross, who serves on the House Armed Services Committee.
